excerpt.zh: 在肃清停留在[FromFrom.System.GetName]的缇扬奇之后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]可以安全地接近墓地，进一步开展研究。
excerpt.en: Having eliminated the Tiyanki stationed in [FromFrom.System.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] can now safely approach the burial ground to conduct their research.
